findings.finding: The capital structure is wrong and blocks dataqa. Debt is 18.4M (AV current portion of LTD at 2026-03-31; the vendor total of 9,590.4M disagrees), but financial debt at 2026-06-30 is 8,545.7M (current 46.7 + non-current 8,499.0, dc_6k_q2_fs). After that come the August 4.5B convertible notes (dc_6k_conv) and the October 3.5B Citi facility (dc_6k_citi). The red-team 'debt_complete passed' only checks the wrong number against itself. forecast warning debt_rate_unusual 334% shows the same error. qa.fields.convertibles is 'missing' although H1 convertibles of 4,337.5M gross are in the pack notes.
findings.where: casefile qa.fields.debt (status conflict, blocking), qa.fields.convertibles, rv.mechanical.redteam.reported.debt_principal_outstanding; fc.warnings debt_rate_unusual
findings.fix: Supply a capital bridge from the 2026-06-30 6-K balance sheet and debt note: financial debt 8,545.7M, convertible instruments with terms, the post-period 4.5B notes (closing to be confirmed) and Citi facility draws. Keep operating leases (1,510.4M non-current) separate. Resolve the debt conflict in qa.resolutions citing dc_6k_q2_fs.

findings.finding: Shares and cash are stale, at 2026-03-31 (215 days old). Shares are 308,971,701 (AV), but point-in-time shares at 2026-06-30 are 271,855,218 (Class A 238,400,165 + Class B 33,455,053, dc_f_sh_a/dc_f_sh_b). Shares issued later are missing: the ATM (12.3M shares left after Q2), the NVIDIA pre-funded warrants (2.0B) and the conversion shares on the convertibles. Cash is 9,298.2M at 3/31 against 8,042.1M at 6/30. Any per-share value would use the wrong count.
findings.fix: Use the 2026-06-30 point-in-time count plus the dated issuances after it (ATM, pre-funded warrants as shares, convertibles as claims or diluted shares) and cash 8,042.1M (dc_6k_q2_fs). Record post_period_events from the 6-Ks of 2026-08-19, 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-22.

findings.finding: sales_to_capital is labelled tier own_history, but the company's own observed level is about 0.20 (ARR 3.0B on 14.98B long-lived assets, as the reason itself says). Base 0.35 and bull 0.45 rest on the ARR guidance, the capex guidance and an assumed share of customer prepayments. The 20-F note says those prepayments are partly refundable, and the refundable share is not disclosed (position gaps).
findings.fix: Relabel the tier as guidance/contracted, or set base at the own observed level (0.20-0.28) with the prepayment uplift as a stated deviation. Show it as an assumption next to the result.
